sources.finding: Some motor control states return energy to the supply. A dissipative external brake path requires feedback and rated power components. This is a general mechanism, not evidence about the unidentified servo or ESC.

Grounded SYNC/MODE selects automatic light-load behavior; DCM avoids negative inductor current. FPWM is a different configuration. Inference with captured U3.17=GND: existing operation is not an accepted regenerative sink. No mode change or reverse-current guarantee is proposed.
Lead inductance and capacitance can produce insertion transients; damping and clamp behavior depend on the network. Source examples do not bound this harness or justify a fixed overshoot multiplier.
Retained VSERVO-01 source requirement: polarized capacitor reverse voltage and repetitive charge/discharge need explicit control. The 16 V part rating does not supply receiver voltage limits.

Maximum cumulative returned energy determines the capacitor excursion. A switched resistive protection path needs both electrical and thermal sizing. No example component values or motor conditions are transferred to this design.
